Cross-sectional relative-spread scarcity: quote-spread panel z-scores, dollar-neutral currency legs
DST-desynchronization premium of the London-NY overlap: conditions the trade on UK/US DST-desync weeks
Pre-release liquidity-withdrawal premium: holds USD basket only in preregistered pre-macro-release windows
Point-in-time rate-differential carry: financing accrual is the mechanism, with swap wedge accounting
Fixing-and-rollover window risk premium: holds exposure through benchmark fixings (Tokyo 09:55, ECB 14:15, WM/R 16:00 London) and the financing hour

comparisons.reasoning: All six new proposals are flat strictly before every rollover instant - exposure at the boundary is identically zero, the exact opposite of the old tradeable object (holding across the boundary). A3-P2's rollover-adjacent narrative sentence does not change the traded object; its signal is the same-day 4-bar NY extension z-score, not same-window trailing drift, and it earns nothing from the rollover itself.

The old mechanism's information is quote-spread dynamics (forbidden data this cycle). No new proposal uses any spread/quote input; A5-P1's relative book is built from prices of two authorized pairs with a lead-lag story, not a scarcity premium.

The old tradeable variable is membership in UK/US DST-desync weeks. No new proposal conditions any signal, filter, gate or arm on DST phase; A4-P2 mentions desync solely as a labeling fact handled by zoneinfo and verifies robustness across desync weeks instead of harvesting them.

The old mechanism holds only preregistered pre-release windows. The new A4-P2 holds every valid day, keeps 08:30 NY releases INSIDE the holding window as a favoring regime, references no macro calendar, and A5-P1 explicitly refuses calendar filtering. Opposite exposure selection.

Financing accrual is the old mechanism's core; this cycle's contract declares financing UNAVAILABLE_FAIL_CLOSED and every new proposal is flat before the rollover with zero financing assumption. Structurally incompatible, not recycled.

The old mechanism holds exposure THROUGH fixing instants and the financing hour. No new proposal references any fixing instant; A5-P1/A5-P2 explicitly never hold the 16:00-17:00 ET fixing-adjacent bar, and 16:00 London falls inside A3-P1/A4-P2 holding windows only incidentally with direction from session momentum, not fixing-flow models. The old FX2-A5-P2 was already INELIGIBLE in the frozen F2 audit; nothing of it reappears.
